title: Pearl River plume variability
query:
Characterize the summer evolution of the Pearl River plume in 2011. Determine how its extent, orientation, and offshore reach vary with shelf circulation and wind conditions, and evaluate the sensitivity of the conclusions to the plume definition.

Independently identify relevant literature and appropriate methods. Deliver an evidence-based report, supporting figures, and one executable analysis notebook. Distinguish demonstrated results from mechanisms that the supplied data cannot establish.
